summary.intent: Monitor a PR for CodeRabbit review comments, resolve all threads by fixing valid issues or marking non-applicable ones, and repeat until no serious comments remain.
summary.outcome: 10 of 19 initial CodeRabbit threads were fixed and all 19 resolved. A second round of review surfaced 1-2 additional issues (key zeroization bug, test quality) which were fixed and staged, but the commit could not be pushed due to a 1Password SSH signing agent failure.

repo: IPFS/IPNS share key field is 'id', not 'ipnsName' — using the wrong field was a real bug in useFolderMutations.ts
IPNS sequenceNumber should start at 1n, not 0n
Blob .buffer should not be used directly; pass the Uint8Array instead in useDropUpload.ts
Bin cleanup on permanentDelete is a known limitation, not a bug to fix
IPNS signature verification being skipped is intentional
Publish order in the SDK requires careful analysis before changing — deferred

code.finding: wrapKey() was outside the try block — if it threw, the IPNS private key would leak without being zeroed. Fix: move wrapKey() inside try/finally to guarantee zeroization on all exit paths.
Pattern: use try/finally (not try/catch + re-zero) for key zeroization so cleanup always runs regardless of throw path.
Test named 'emits bin:updated' only checked no-throw, not the actual event — test name and assertion were mismatched. Also had 'as any' casts that could be replaced with typed predicates.
Missing beforeEach(clearAllMocks) — test state could leak between cases.
Duplicate name checks for both createFolder and upload need to happen before the operation, not after.
Previous key was not being zeroed in cache on error path.

workflow: CodeRabbit does an incremental re-review after a push — wait ~3 min after pushing to check for new threads before declaring done.
Batch-resolving GitHub PR threads via CLI is viable but requires careful thread ID management.
1Password SSH agent can fail intermittently, blocking signed commits — staged changes survive the session.

friction: 1Password SSH signing agent failed repeatedly, blocking the final commit and push — required manual user intervention.
CodeRabbit posted duplicate threads (e.g., #19 same as #14) adding noise to the review process.
User was AFK during the SSH failure window, causing a pause in the workflow.
open_items: Final commit with key zeroization fix and test improvements is staged but not yet pushed — user needs to push after 1Password recovery.
Publish order safety in the SDK needs careful analysis before any changes are made (CodeRabbit thread #16 deferred).
Bin cleanup on permanentDelete is a known limitation with no current fix planned.
